claim_text: Jemal et al. (2024) introduced a graph convolutional network combined with a Mamba state-space sequence model to capture inter-channel spatial synchrony for cross-patient seizure prediction.
source_title: Domain adaptation for EEG-based, cross-subject epileptic seizure prediction
source_excerpt: The basic neural network architecture of this model is then adapted to cross-subject prediction... cross-subject modeling is enhanced by domain adaptation
label: MISATTRIBUTED
explanation: Jemal et al. (2024) uses domain adaptation neural networks (DANN, CDAN, CDAN+E) on an EEGNet-style convolutional architecture -- it does not use graph convolutional networks or Mamba state-space models. The architecture described in the claim (CNN-GCN-Mamba-BiLSTM) belongs to a separate paper, Chen et al.'s 'CG-MambaNet' (arXiv:2606.08226). Both papers address cross-patient seizure prediction on overlapping datasets (CHB-MIT, SIENA), which makes this an easy mix-up to make but a real one, since the underlying architectures are unrelated.
